attempts.note: SEKA publishes 106 N/mm rear vertical compliance and up to 16 mm seatpost movement while claiming no compromise to lateral stiffness.

attempts.note: The reviewer found no issue at 200–270 W but reports rear lateral flex disrupting shifting above about 360 W across four wheelsets.

notes: Both axes and evidence bases are shown; no universal stiffness score or threshold is inferred.
